<a id="catalogue-acceptance-matrix"></a>

## 3. Catalogue Acceptance Matrix

This is the active M2 completion ledger for all 53 stable catalogue IDs. Gate definitions, exact scenario IDs and required platform profiles live in [the acceptance rubric](roadmap.md#31-acceptance-rubric). A cell ID is `CAT.<manifest-id>.G<n>`; native scenario cells extend it with platform/profile/scenario/case as specified there. Every mandatory capability and scenario must be instantiated and resolved before its aggregate gate can pass. An empty or uninstantiated scenario set is not vacuous success.

`OPEN` is an administrative state before reconciliation/execution; it is not a failed test. Final verification dispositions are `PASS`, `FAIL`, `BLOCKED`, `N/A(reason)` or `OWNER-DEFERRED(authority)`. Historical passes retain their recorded scope and artifacts; opening a broader aggregate cell does not invalidate those receipts or promote them to full current-matrix acceptance. Source availability is tracked in the roadmap catalogue separately. The table initially leaves unreconciled aggregates open rather than inventing complete proof from earlier test counts.

Current required native scenario projection for CircularProgress, Counter, partial Carousel, supplemental Button/Text typography, shared ClickPopover host obligations and private Tooltip/HoverPopover: [section3.31.3](#3313-private-tooltip-surfaces-and-required-native-matrix), source producer 5ffa805, preserves all 3,910 CP-44 cells and 400 old-to-current ID aliases unchanged while adding 3,396 explicit tooltip/hover obligations. All 7,306 projected installed cells remain OPEN/null with 0 native actions. This remains a supplemental projection rather than the whole 53-component matrix; other families retain their checkpoint matrices and unresolved aggregate cells. CP-51 in §3.31.29 verifies the current public consumer/graphs at 6103855 and exact public Release reuse; private Menu native acceptance remains OPEN. Private Pagination construction and every remaining native acceptance obligation stay open. The 110 activation/release installed cells and private Breadcrumbs runtime remain OPEN. The 43 new relationship obligations also remain OPEN, with one platform-specific N/A; this projection does not replace the whole 53-component matrix. The navigation/current metadata projection now has 39 scoped PASS (21 Android/18 iOS), 34 OPEN and three platform-specific N/A fields in §3.31.28. The original iOS log failure remains preserved; the new file-receipt cohort proves its exact observed forms. Later source changes require their own matching proof.

CP-72 in [section3.31.54](#33154-toaster-keyboard-source-oracle-and-observation-decision) is the current sealed public consumer/build checkpoint atc2e4fde, covering41 public source counterparts and the JS observation-lease correction. All private/installed/profile/closure statuses and the inherited transitive structured-clone distinction remain required OPEN.

### 3.3. Display Primitive Source And Consumer Checkpoint

Source commit `199aadc` implements Indicator/LineSegment on the approved conventional native mapping, with pure component-owned typed calibration and a shared private static-dimension validator. Canonical horizontal/vertical token geometry is retained rather than renamed. Current foreground, inactive border behavior, native colors, all shapes, registered/array styles, post-custom callback defaults, explicit zero/percent dimensions, native refs/identity/layout payloads and wrapper consumption are covered by the named capability cases in roadmap Section 3.5.1. No dependency, palette, controlled text, native service or signing change is made.

The maintained Indicator/Segment composition is committed in `4db67b2`; its two cases cover controlled false/zero through theme/window/fixture changes, explicit reset, every shape, geometry/direction, colors, border, owned Button foreground and final overrides. Seventeen retained NativeShowcase cases also pass. Source review of the pinned RN Android accessibility delegate identifies no mapping for the separator ARIA role; `9b2d345` uses an explicitly named generic native View in the example instead of implying a separator trait. Its affected composition cases and normal app hooks pass. Public role forwarding remains native View behavior, not a claim that every upstream enum has a platform trait.

CP-20 uses a fresh `/private/tmp/codon-native-library-consumer-199aadc` with the exact existing SDK/peer/tool/Intl tuple and the packed native archive only. The initial offline install succeeds in 8.9 seconds; a new node_modules tree installs under the unchanged frozen lock. All ten public contract files import the packed native barrel; TypeScript tracing verifies all 20 imports resolve to dist/index.d.ts with no errors. The host and library resolve identical React19.2.3, RN0.86.3 and safe-area5.7.0 peer roots; Expo57.0.26 and number utility3.6.6 remain pinned. The final 14-file maintained app fixture matches `9b2d345`. Both Hermes JS exports pass; maps contain 680 Android/682 iOS source entries, each with 67 library runtime sources whose actual and embedded contents match the archive. All 230 installed source/declaration/runtime/manifest files match the archive. The original successful `4db67b2` JS proof is retained separately before refreshing the reviewed fixture. #### 3.31.54. Toaster Keyboard Source Oracle And Observation Decision

Evidence key: TKO-01. Source baselineb173a14, feature/native-toaster-completion. This is full-family preparation for the public Toaster boundary, not a catalogue promotion. The executable nonshipping oracle imports the actual canonical isHotkeyPressed and Toaster. Twenty real KeyboardEvent cases prove physical code versus logical character, empty/modifier-only arrays, incompatible codes, key/code/location/repeat/composition, method/prototype truthiness, unknown properties, defaultPrevented and bubbles. The real mounted Toaster receives its normal observer publications, then two actual document keydown dispatches (physical KeyE/logical q, Alt) expand and collapse it, including repeat, while dispatch returns true and defaultPrevented remains false. Its first fixture queries the list before canonical deferred publication; findByRole waits for the actual mounted list and the final21-case oracle passes. The native implementation has not been represented as passing these source cases.

Current native model converts physical-looking strings into logical tokens; its scope only dispatches records with nativeDefaultHandled=true. Native Toaster ignores repeat, while the source handler does not. UIKit's current owned recognizer explicitly recognizes matching consuming policies with cancellation/delay enabled. Android returns capture(event) || super.dispatchKeyEvent(event). Reusing that path for observation would suppress or alter source defaults. Roadmap §3.5.50 proposes a separate private observation path using the existing window hosts, passive recognizer/original Android dispatch, physical code tables and independent live ordered leases. Public key/press/focus APIs, component props/payload names, pins/palette, actual refs and controlled values remain unchanged.
